payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear overview of the diverse topics discussed on Reddit, including specific examples and the nature of discussions.

claims.text: Reddit discussions cover a wide range of topics including climate change, abortion, world news, relationship advice, and artificial intelligence.
Subreddits are oriented around specific interests such as politics, business, science, and technology.
Dogmatism is prevalent in discussions about politics and religion, while topics like cooking tend to have lower levels of dogmatism.
Users who are dogmatic about one topic often express dogmatic views about other unrelated topics as well.
